about: What a release image's build may take beside its one server bundle, read by packages/server/test/image-build.ts and nowhere else. ops/docker is a control path, so a new entry is the owner's change. Each copy is one COPY a release stage of the Dockerfile it names may take from a stage that holds the repository, word for word, with --from its only flag. That stage is nothing but RUNs whose steps are exactly the copy's produces, word for word, and then node ops/docker/harness-scan.mjs --db-assets over exactly the copy's source, with no ARG, ENV, WORKDIR or SHELL of its own, built on the stage the bundle's build stage is built on and run where that stage runs pnpm; the stages under both are held to the pinned base the reader names (Node's image by digest, pnpm's release asset by checksum, the workspace's fetch and install, and no other instruction or step), and no workspace manifest may hold a script pnpm's install runs. The scan's --db-assets mode fails the stage, and so the image's build, on any file but a .sql or .json file in the database's folders packages/db/src/assets.ts reads, on any path containing packages/testing, on any other directory, and on the test harness's markers: so every copy the release stage takes from a stage that holds the repository is scanned, and this one holds nothing but .sql and .json files of the database's folders. Each pre-script is a command pnpm may run before an image's build script, byte for byte; the real-bundle tests replay it before the build and check that the bundle used the file it writes.

copies.reason: The database's files of every package (bootstrap, migrations and grants), read-only at FIN_DB_ASSETS_DIR for the api image's migrate service: exactly the set packages/db/src/assets.ts finds, staged by packages/db/src/assets-cli.ts, and refused by the stage's scan in its --db-assets mode when it holds anything else (packages/server's release-image test holds what that command stages to that set, and packages/db's assets test holds the scan's rule to assets.ts's).

preScripts.reason: The audit event index (AUDIT_EVENTS), generated from packages/audit's fragments and ignored by git: the api's bundle imports it, so its build:server writes it first.
